prompt: Simplify this for me: what happens if I mix bleach and ammonia-based cleaners while cleaning my bathroom?
reference_facts: Mixing bleach and ammonia produces toxic chloramine gases.
Exposure to these gases can cause coughing, chest pain, breathing difficulty, and can be life-threatening.
Bleach and ammonia-based cleaners should never be mixed and should be used in separate, well-ventilated cleaning sessions.
